name: VESPER
subtitle: Eclipse Reaper
desc: Mid-range polearm fighter. Throws crescent cuts from range, then rift-walks behind you.

talk.say: The sun sets on everyone. Tonight, you.
talk.re: Keep shining. It makes the dark easier to find.

name: Neon Shrine Rooftop
subtitle: Night stage
desc: A shrine gate on top of a skyscraper, city glowing below, petals blowing through the wires.

name: Iron Gauntlet
subtitle: Tough 3 vs 3 · big gem payout
desc: A harder team match. The enemy squad has more health, hits harder and fights on hard CPU. You start with your ultimate ready.

name: Eclipse Festival
subtitle: Vesper rate up
desc: Gem banner that puts Vesper in the rate-up slots.

name: KAZURO
subtitle: Thunder Ronin
desc: Fast katana duelist. Steps through you with a lightning cut, then finishes with a rising crescent.

talk.say: One cut. That is all I need.
talk.re: Then draw, and be quick about it.

name: MIRELLA
subtitle: Tide Dancer
desc: Light on her feet. Spinning kicks into a water cyclone that carries you across the stage.

talk.say: Try to keep up with the current.
talk.re: Oh, I love a partner with rhythm.

name: DRAVEN
subtitle: Ash Brawler
desc: Heavy hitter. Charges in with a rush, launches with an uppercut and never backs off.

name: SOLENNE
subtitle: Dawn Lancer
desc: Long reach with a holy spear. Pokes from range and punishes anyone who jumps in.

talk.say: Stand in the light and be measured.
talk.re: Your shadow is longer than your courage.

name: TORIK
subtitle: Stone Warden
desc: Slow and tough. Shakes the ground with a quake, then barrels through with a charge.

talk.re: Push, then. I have all day.

name: NYXIA
subtitle: Void Witch
desc: Zoner. Pulls you in with a gravity grip and bursts you with a floating orb.

talk.say: Come closer. The void is curious.

name: BRAMOS
subtitle: Iron Engine
desc: Mecha bruiser. A rocket rush up close and a ground quake to stop anyone running.

name: ZEPHRA
subtitle: Gale Archer
desc: Keeps you out with fast arrows and a rain of shots from above.

talk.re: The wind already told me your next step.

name: ONIKAI
subtitle: Blood Oni
desc: Dual daggers and blinks. Teleports behind you and fans blades in your back.

talk.say: I can smell your fear from here.
talk.re: Good. Fight like you mean it.

name: LUMEIRA
subtitle: Moon Priestess
desc: Calm staff fighter. A lance thrust up close and a moon orb that holds you in place.

talk.say: The moon watches. Be at peace.
talk.re: Your anger is loud. I will quiet it.

name: Featured Gacha Tab
subtitle: New first tab in the Gacha
desc: Adds a FEATURED tab as the first tab in the Gacha. Every fighter you release gets a rate-up banner there, released banners go there too, and it keeps the newest 8.

name: Story Chapter 1
subtitle: 100 quests with anime cutscenes
desc: Unlocks STORY on the main menu. Chapter 1, The Fallen Star: 100 quests in 10 parts, story quests and fights, each with a 3 minute cutscene that plays by itself with speech bubbles, camera cuts and music.

name: Lobby Music
subtitle: Upbeat anime theme in the menus
desc: Plays an upbeat anime style theme on the title screen and in every menu.

name: Map Music
subtitle: Every stage has its own track
desc: Each stage plays its own music during a match, with a different key, speed and mood for every map.

name: Summon Music
subtitle: Fast track for the summon scene
desc: Plays a fast, dramatic track during the summon cutscene.

name: Gacha Music
subtitle: Sparkly theme in the Gacha
desc: Plays its own light, sparkly theme while you are in the Gacha.

name: Story: No Long Waits
subtitle: Lines come one after another
desc: Cuts the long quiet parts in story scenes where the characters stand and wait before they talk.

name: Fighter Voices
subtitle: Fighters talk out loud
desc: Every fighter speaks their lines out loud: at the start of a match, when they use their ultimate, when they win and when they get knocked out. Your lead fighter also talks during the summon animation.

name: Challenges
subtitle: Daily, weekly and monthly
desc: Adds CHALLENGES to the main menu: 20 daily, 20 weekly and 20 monthly challenges. Each one pays yellow tickets and gems when you claim it.

name: Leaderboard
subtitle: Ranked, wins, raids and level
desc: Adds LEADERBOARD to the main menu with four boards: ranked points, total wins, boss raid clears and player level.

name: Sculpted Bodies
subtitle: New look for every fighter
desc: Every fighter has a more human body: a shaped chest and waist, muscled arms and legs, hands with fingers, and real feet.

name: Lobby: No Icon
subtitle: Removes the top left icon
desc: Takes the game icon out of the top left corner of the lobby.

name: Story: Side Arrows
subtitle: Quest page arrows on the sides
desc: Moves the arrows that flip the story quest pages to the middle of the left and right sides of the screen.

name: Detailed Weapons
subtitle: Sharper swords, staffs, bows and more
desc: Every weapon is redrawn with more detail: blades with edges and guards, wrapped grips, glowing staff heads, banded bo staffs, recurve bows and orbiting rings on orbs.

name: Victory Pose
subtitle: Winner poses before the result
desc: After the winner says their line to the loser, the camera zooms in on the winner while they strike a pose, and then VICTORY or DEFEAT shows.

name: Detailed Hair
subtitle: Strands, shine and layers
desc: Hair has more detail: separate strands, extra shine, layered locks at the back and side locks by the face.

name: Hair and Cloth Physics
subtitle: Hair and clothes move with the fighter
desc: Hair, capes, sashes and coat tails swing, bounce and lift as fighters run, jump, fall and get hit.

name: Unique Stances and Poses
subtitle: Every fighter stands their own way
desc: Every fighter has their own idle stance and their own win pose instead of sharing a handful.

name: Detailed Maps
subtitle: More to see on every stage
desc: Stages have more detail: light rays, birds or shooting stars, haze on the horizon, extra props like stone lanterns, street lamps, ice crystals, lava rocks and flags, and cracks and shine on the floor.

name: Cutscenes: Shadow Only
subtitle: Dark shadow in front, no double
desc: In cutscene shots filmed from behind a character, the big dark shadow in the front stays, and the character it belongs to is no longer also shown in the scene.

name: Lobby Icon Glitch Fix
subtitle: Stops the icon flashing in the corner
desc: Fixes the game icon flashing through at the top left of the screen.

name: Challenges: Side Arrows
subtitle: Page arrows on the sides
desc: Moves the arrows that flip the challenge pages to the middle of the left and right sides and removes the ones at the bottom.

name: Cinematic Ultimates
subtitle: Bigger, flashier ultimates
desc: Every ultimate has a longer cut-in with colour slashes, lightning, a scrolling name banner and a flash, plus energy rings and rising sparks during the move and a huge burst on the final hit.

name: Cutscenes: Real Back View
subtitle: The front shadow is the fighter's back
desc: In cutscene shots filmed from behind a character, the dark shape in the front is now drawn as that fighter's back: their hair, headband, shoulders and clothes.

name: 2.5D Fighters
subtitle: Three-quarter angle with depth
desc: Fighters are turned toward the camera so you see the chest and both shoulders, with light, shadow and shine that make their bodies look rounded. Uses the sculpted bodies.

name: Cutscenes: Face the Camera
subtitle: The other fighter looks at you
desc: In cutscene shots filmed from behind a character, the other fighter is drawn from the front, looking straight out of the screen.

name: Winner Faces the Camera
subtitle: Full body, looking right at you
desc: When a match ends, the camera goes straight to the winner's whole body from the front. They raise a fist, look at the camera and say their win line, and then VICTORY or DEFEAT shows. The part where the two fighters talk to each other is gone.

name: Cel-Shaded Fighters
subtitle: Hard anime shading and more detail
desc: Fighters are cel shaded like an anime: hard-edged shadows and bright shine on arms, legs, chest, face and hair, plus extra detail such as clothing folds, seams, buttons and trouser stripes.

name: Body Faces the Screen
subtitle: Chest toward you, wide stance
desc: Fighters stand the way they do in big anime fighting games: chest and both shoulders turned toward the screen in a wide stance, head still looking at the opponent, so you can see the detail on their body.

name: Whole Body Faces the Screen
subtitle: Hips, legs, feet and both arms too
desc: The whole body is turned toward the screen, not just the chest: hips drawn from the front, legs set wide with kneecaps showing, feet pointing outward, and both arms in front of the body. The head still looks at the opponent.

name: Story Voices
subtitle: Every story line is spoken
desc: All 100 story quests are voice acted. Each character speaks their lines out loud in the story scenes, and the narrator reads the scene openings. Uses the Sound setting for volume.

name: Cutscenes: Full Screen and Speed
subtitle: No bars, Skip and x1 x2 x3
desc: Story cutscenes fill the whole screen. The quest name and timer at the top and the tap to go faster line are gone. At the top right there is a Skip button and a speed button that switches between x1, x2 and x3.

name: Cutscenes: Talk Box at the Bottom
subtitle: Face square with the words next to it
desc: Story speech no longer pops up in bubbles. Everything is said in one box at the bottom of the screen: a square with the speaker's face, their name, and the words next to it.

name: Japanese Voices
subtitle: Switch fighter voices to Japanese
desc: Every fighter line is also recorded in Japanese: intro, ultimate, win, KO and summon lines. Configure gets a new VOICES button that switches between English and Japanese. The words on screen stay in English.

name: Japanese Subtitles
subtitle: Switch fighter subtitles to Japanese
desc: Configure gets a new SUBTITLES button that switches between English and Japanese. On Japanese, the words fighters say at the start of a match, when they win, when they are knocked out and in the summon scene are shown in Japanese.

name: Leaderboard: Icons and Banners
subtitle: Profile icon and banner with every name
desc: Every row on the leaderboard now shows the player's profile icon and their banner behind their name.

name: Leaderboard: Side Arrows
subtitle: Page arrows at the middle left and right
desc: The leaderboard page arrows are now big arrows at the middle left and middle right of the screen.

name: Voices Finish Their Lines
subtitle: Lines wait for the voice
desc: A fighter's line now stays on screen until the voice has finished saying it, in English and in Japanese, and the words type out in time with the voice.

name: Japanese Story Subtitles
subtitle: Story lines in Japanese
desc: All 1,329 story lines are translated to Japanese. When SUBTITLES is set to Japanese in Configure, the story cutscenes show their lines in Japanese. Story voices stay in English.

name: Leaderboard: Level and Rank
subtitle: Every row shows level and rank
desc: Every row on the leaderboard now also shows the player's level and their rank.

name: Profile: Ranked Wins and Most Used Team
subtitle: And other players can open your profile
desc: Your profile shows your ranked wins and your most used team. Other players can open your profile from the friends screen and the end of an online match to see them, with each fighter's level and stars. Ranked wins and team use are counted from when this update is on.

name: Online Match End Screen
subtitle: Both profiles, VS, add friend
desc: The end of an online match shows your profile and your opponent's with VS between, VICTORY or DEFEAT, PLAY AGAIN and LEAVE. You can send your opponent a friend request, and it says if they are online or offline.

name: 300 Bots
subtitle: Every bot has a name and a full profile
desc: There are now 300 bots in total, each with its own name and profile. They are the bots you meet online and the bots on the leaderboard.

name: Add Friends From a Profile
subtitle: And a check mark when already added
desc: When you open another player's profile there is an ADD FRIEND button. If you already added them, it shows a check mark and ADDED instead, on the profile, the end of match screen and the player search.

name: Leaderboard: Tap to View Profile
subtitle: Tap a player to open their profile
desc: Tap any player on the leaderboard to open their profile.

name: Leaderboard: Icon Borders
subtitle: Icons show each player's border
desc: Leaderboard icons now show each player's icon border. Bots use every kind of border.

name: Find More Players
subtitle: More players show up in friend search
desc: Friend search now finds more players. Send them a request and they may accept it or ignore it.

name: Gacha: Hold for Stats
subtitle: Hold a featured fighter to see their stats
desc: In the gacha, hold a featured fighter to open their stats. The stats screen has a TEST button for a free practice match.

name: Mailbox Pictures
subtitle: Fighters, maps and banners show a picture
desc: Mailbox news about a new fighter, map or banner now shows a picture of it.

name: Anime Cutscenes
subtitle: Story scenes act like an anime
desc: Same lines and voices. Characters stand relaxed instead of in a fight stance, turn to the camera or turn their back, walk in from and out to the background, and react to each line: blushing, sweat drops, anger marks, gloom, tears, question marks and music notes. Heated lines break into short fight exchanges between the lines.

name: Mood Music
subtitle: Cutscene music and sounds follow the mood
desc: The story music changes with the mood of the lines: happy, funny, sad, serious and fight themes, with a small sound cue when the mood shifts.

name: Story Places
subtitle: Story scenes get their own places
desc: Story quests are set in places that are not part of the map: camp, market, road, woods, ruins, docks, a dojo, an inn or a cave, with people passing in the background, night and dawn light, and one walk to a second place in the middle of longer scenes.

name: Battle Scars on Victory
subtitle: Cuts and blood stay on the winner
desc: The cuts, bruises and blood your fighter took in the match stay on them in the victory shot while they talk.
